sections.label: Small Motorised Vehicles Bill debate
sections.summary: The speaker says amendments in both Bills were already explained and members raised questions and views in the earlier debate.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In the debate, we have just had on the Small Motorised Vehicles Bill, I have already explained the amendments proposed in both Bills.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Members have already raised their questions and expressed their views on both Bills during the earlier debate, although they are still welcome to do so now if there are any additional questions or views.
